clippings.speaker: Sam Raimi
clippings.quote: I had to call Tobey and say "Tobey from what I hear I can't work with you in the movie" and he was speechless.
clippings.title: An Interview with Sam Raimi
clippings.context: Raimi recalls telling Maguire he could not work with him on the sequel because of his back, in a June 2004 interview promoting Spider-Man 2.

clippings.speaker: Sam Raimi
clippings.quote: I did want to beat him up emotionally and mentally I wanted him to suffer and make the audiences suffer.
clippings.title: An Interview with Sam Raimi
clippings.context: Answering whether he roughed up Maguire's character on purpose, in a June 2004 interview promoting Spider-Man 2.

clippings.speaker: Sam Raimi
clippings.quote: The way Tobey did that performance, it looked like he had lived kind of a hard life as Spider-Man. So it was really emotional and so well done, but it was also like spending an afternoon with old friends who I hadn’t seen in 15 years.
clippings.title: Doctor Strange 2 Director Sam Raimi on Kevin Feige’s Spider-Man Genius
clippings.context: Raimi reflects on seeing Maguire return as Peter Parker in No Way Home, in a May 2022 interview about Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness.

clippings.speaker: Tobey Maguire
clippings.quote: Sam was very open to me contributing all of my ideas, both from a story standpoint, tonally, content of scenes, everything. He was very open and would listen and I think would use stuff when it was good and dismiss it when it wasn't.
clippings.title: SPIDER-MAN 3: An Interview with Tobey Maguire, continued
clippings.context: Maguire describes how Raimi let him shape the story, tone and scenes on Spider-Man 3, in an April 2007 interview by Chris Tongue.

clippings.speaker: Tobey Maguire
clippings.quote: I feel like it’s both ways. I think that he’s attracted to it and repulsed by it at the same time.
clippings.title: SPIDER-MAN 3: An Interview with Tobey Maguire
clippings.context: Maguire on Raimi's ambivalence about the darker Spider-Man scenes, in an April 2007 interview by Chris Tongue; he disputes Raimi's stated reason for finding them hardest.

clippings.speaker: Tobey Maguire
clippings.quote: …and Sam was involved and the right cast was in place, at that point I would consider it.
clippings.title: SPIDER-MAN 3: An Interview with Tobey Maguire
clippings.context: Asked whether he would return for a fourth film, Maguire ties his answer to Raimi's involvement, in an April 2007 interview by Chris Tongue.
